issues: 118 K1 pages whose UNII SMILES separates into a core plus a metal or other fragment that is not a recognised counter-ion were NOT merged (gadolinium, technetium, lutetium, platinum, iron, bismuth and the like). Removing such a fragment would replace a metal complex with its free ligand, which §1 does not permit.
50 salt or solvate forms have no page holding their parent structure, so they stay their own page; §3.1 merges into a parent that exists, and this pass never creates one.

the ethane page (K1:L99N5N533T) keeps suppression class S10 (unknown) after the split: it is still withheld, but the S1 ATC and S8 register facts it used to show belonged to dimethyl fumarate and were removed rather than restated. A full re-run of scripts/corpus-20k/suppression/assign.py is the way to give it its own reading.
data/corpus-20k/questions, derived and render still hold the pre-pass-2 key set: they are rebuilt from these artefacts and must be regenerated before any load.
